context.transcript:
How is this microwave oven different from others?
A. It has a longer warranty.
B. It's too hot in this room.
C. We have several.
context.transcript_translation:
这个微波炉和别的有什么不同？
A. 它有更长的保修期。
B. 这个房间太热了。
C. 我们有好几个。

choices: It's too hot in this room.
items.question: How is this microwave oven different from others?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“How is this microwave oven different from others?”，自然应答是“It has a longer warranty.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：A（It has a longer warranty.）。
